presets.hide_date_fields:
# Hide any values for all date fields
hide due date
hide scheduled date
hide start date
hide created date
hide done date
hide cancelled date
presets.hide_non_date_fields:
# Hide all the non-date fields, but not tags
hide id
hide depends on
hide recurrence rule
hide on completion
hide priority
presets.hide_query_elements:
# Hide postpone, edit and backinks
hide postpone button
hide edit button
hide backlinks
presets.hide_everything:
# Hide everything except description and any tags
preset hide_date_fields
preset hide_non_date_fields
preset hide_query_elements
presets.tareas_de_hoy:
# Tareas con fecha de hoy (o ya pasadas) PENDIENTES
not done
(tags include #task) OR (tags include #question) OR (tags include #conclusión)
path does not include Notas/Hogar/Despensa
(due today) OR (scheduled today) OR (due before today) OR (scheduled before today)
group by priority
show tree
hide backlink
hide task count
hide toolbar
presets.tareas_de_esta_nota:
# Tareas definidas en esta nota PENDIENTES
not done 
(tags include #task) OR (tags include #question) OR (tags include #conclusión)
path does not include Notas/Hogar/Despensa
path includes {{query.file.path}}
show tree
hide backlink
hide task count
hide toolbar
presets.tareas_de_esta_nota_todas:
# Tareas definidas en esta nota PENDIENTES 
(tags include #task) OR (tags include #question) OR (tags include #conclusión)
path does not include Notas/Hogar/Despensa
path includes {{query.file.path}}
show tree
hide backlink
hide task count
hide toolbar

globalQuery: ((tags include #task) OR (tags include #question) OR (tags include #conversación) OR (tags include #email) OR (tags include #conclusión)) OR (path includes Notas/Hogar/Despensa)
